messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. Two asks for the kernel-v2 canary: 1) a terse ops checklist we can run during the 48h window, and 2) recommended batching/cache defaults for conversational workloads that target p50 <120ms. Also: what's the neatest way to tag traces so we can slice by batch-profile?

nora: Short checklist (ops): smoke deploy -> run synthetic load (small bursts) -> verify p50/p95 and KV hit ratio -> watch OOMs and GPU temp -> sanity-check logs for stalls. If anything looks off, pin traffic to v1 and file incident. I'll write this up into a checklist doc.

leo: For batch/cache defaults we've been using conservative settings for live chat: microbatch_window_ms=6, max_batch_size=10, kv_prewarm=false, kv_adaptive=true. That gives decent p50 while keeping resident mem modest. If you can accept the mem bump, set kv_prewarm=true (helps tail latency).

anya: Can you quantify "modest" for mem bump? Trying to justify to SRE.

leo: Rough numbers: kv_prewarm=false -> baseline; true -> +8-15% resident mem on typical 30k-token model. Highly workload dependent. We can run a short mem-profile before canary starts.

samir: Kernel-v2 timeline: internal canary next week for a tiny Dedicated pool, wider canary in ~3 weeks, GA in ~2 months if no regressions. v2 includes plumbing for quantized kernels (int8 experimental opt-in) but int8 won't be default at GA.

diana: Ops gating thresholds suggestion: abort if p50 > 150ms sustained for 3m OR p95 > 500ms for 2m OR OOMs > 0 for 10m. Also flag if KV hit ratio drops >20% vs baseline. Those will trigger automated rollback + pager.

nora: Example minimal canary config we recommend (paste into canary pool):
```yaml
runtime:
  kernel: v2
  pool: canary-small
batching:
  enabled: true
  microbatch_window_ms: 6
  max_batch_size: 10
cache:
  kv_prewarm: false
  kv_adaptive: true
  eviction_policy: clock
monitoring:
  trace_tags: ["canary:kernel-v2","batch_profile"]
  trace_sample_rate: 100%
```

leo: Perf tips: if you see head-of-line blocking, reduce max_batch_size or set a per-request latency cap and route tiny requests to a latency-first pool. Also consider enabling prefix caching for very common prompts.

anya: Perfect. Last one: what's the canonical link for the rollback/playbook we should point people to?

nora: Internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/runtime-canary (ops-only). I'll add the checklist + thresholds there and ping the on-call.

ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled -> job #5012 (kernel-v2) on canary-small. ETA 04:15 UTC.

anya: Thanks so much — I'll turn this into a checklist and post in the canary channel. Please drop any short tuning scripts or simulators here if you've got them. :rocket:
